data.description:
## Description

**What**: Update project docs for the cross-session PR ownership feature.
**Why**: A new PreToolUse hook, a new permitted-path wrapper, and a CLAUDE.md "Never Do These" rule are introduced; reference docs must stay in sync.
**Scope**:
- IN: document check-pr-destructive-action.sh (PreToolUse hook) and the pr-destructive-action.sh single-permitted-path wrapper in HOOKS-REFERENCE.md; surface the CLAUDE.md rule 25 negative-directive addition as a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report.
- OUT: new standalone docs unless a router gate directs to an ADR; direct CLAUDE.md edits (Gate 5 requires a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report, surfaced to the user).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, doc updates exist for every router gate that fired (new hook, wrapper) and the completion report includes the DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block; any CLAUDE.md rule-25 change is surfaced as a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report, not a direct edit
  ← Satisfies: sc-4  (sc-4: "New PreToolUse hook check-pr-destructive-action.sh blocks any direct gh pr destructive invocation ...")

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Apply plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, I want project docs updated for cross-session PR ownership enforcement
